# Scribe

> Tab, Tab, Apply Brilliance – an open-source AI writing tool that seamlessly integrates real-time inline suggestions, style consistency, and document management into a distraction-free writing workflow.

Scribe transforms the writing process by placing AI-powered recommendations directly in your text as you type. It refines clarity, grammar, and style without interrupting creative flow. Writers can organize projects, track revisions, and publish content—all within a single interface.

## Core Features
- [Inline Suggestions](/documents): Contextual recommendations that appear as you write
- [Style Consistency](/documents): Maintain your unique voice with AI-driven edits
- [Document Management](/documents): Create, organize, and track revisions in one place
- [Publishing Tools](/documents): Publish articles or share links directly from the platform

## Key Pages
- [Home](/): Feature overview and demo
- [Login](/login): Secure authentication
